messages:
sara_support: FYI customer ACME reporting intermittent 503s and long tail timeouts on hosted generate endpoint since ~10:10 UTC. Large batch workloads (~45-60k tokens) often cut the stream mid-response. They also reported duplicate token charges from client retries. trace: acme-20250305-abc123

alex_eng_oncall: Ack. Can you paste model, SDK version, sample request (curl) and any trace/request ids? Any headers like x-rw-trace or x-client-id? :eyes:

sara_support: Model: redwood-v2-medium (hosted). SDK: rw-sdk-js v0.9.1. Customer sent this curl and saw 503 then retry -> 504. Gateway logs show 'upstream reset' and 'write timeout'. Example below:

```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-medium","input":"<very long prompt...>"}' \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

julian_sre: Also need p95/p99 token latency and gw ingress metrics around 10:00-10:20. Can you attach /metrics snapshot? @deploy-bot any deploys near 09:58?

deploy-bot: canary-redwood-runtime v2.14 -> v2.15 deployed at 2025-03-05T09:58:21Z (success) :white_check_mark:

maria_research: Quick hypothesis: retry amplification. Client retries on partial streaming failures + our requeue on worker failover => duplicate work and queue growth. If kvcache locks or eviction thrash occurs, expensive re-execs pile up. We should attempt a repro with 200 concurrent streaming requests that include large prompts to trigger the path.

sara_support: Customer shared a repro script. Running 50 concurrent streaming requests reproduces failures locally. Attaching small log snippet where you can see repeated request ids and retry loops:

```
[10:11:22] request=acme-1 status=503 upstream=reset
[10:11:23] request=acme-1 retry=1 status=503 write_timeout
[10:11:24] request=acme-1 retry=2 status=504 client_timeout
```

alex_eng_oncall: I'll spin up staging using the same runtime image and enable debug logging. Temporary mitigation for customer: set sdk retry_count=2 with jitter, enable streaming resume where possible, and fallback to smaller model. pls notify customer.

acmeops_custrep: Messaging customer now: "Please reduce concurrency to 20 and set sdk retry_count=2 with exponential backoff. We'll follow up with a fix and timeline." :thumbsup:

julian_sre: In gateway logs I see worker pool connection resets at ~10:12 and the worker processes show elevated memory and eviction rates. Several worker OOMs within minutes, preceded by high KV cache eviction. Opening incident INC-2025-103 for deeper triage.

sara_support: Customer is worried about billing — they saw what look like duplicate token charges during the retry storms. @billing-team can you check if duplicate billing events correlate with trace acme-20250305-abc123?

billing-team: Received. We'll correlate invoice events and token usage windows and report back within 2 business hours.

alex_eng_oncall: Plan: (1) hotfix to avoid requeue on partial_stream_reset, (2) ensure tokens aren't double-counted when upstream fails before final bytes, (3) add guard to reject >40k token requests on hosted tier with a helpful error. I'll target a staged hotfix in ~4h.

deploy-bot: hotfix branch built and tests green in staging. Requesting prod deploy window.

maria_research: Also recommend a runtime routing rule: if request_size > 40k tokens, automatically route to dedicated pool or suggest batch-splitting to the SDK. Will add to Optimize suggestions.

acmeops_custrep: Customer acknowledged mitigations and will reduce concurrency and retries. They asked for ETA and asked we pause any immediate billing captures until we confirm.

sara_support: Owner: sara_support. Will update this thread with staging results and prod deploy ETA. Next update in 2h or sooner.
